batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b VS Malik

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c SK Trivedi b JP Faulkner

batting.name: GH Vihari
batting.dismissal: c KK Cooper b VS Malik

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c KK Cooper b SK Trivedi

batting.name: NLTC Perera
batting.dismissal: c DH Yagnik b SR Watson

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c KV Sharma b I Sharma

batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c DJG Sammy b KV Sharma

balls.text: fuller on the off stump and he unwinds there, gets it straight down the ground for a couple of runs, the long-off fielder dives and stops it
full-toss on the leg stump, that's tapped back to the bowler, who fumbles and that slows the ball down while going down to long-on, allows them to come back for the second
fullish outside the off stump, dug out to the point region for a single

fuller and quicker on the off stump, driven down to long-on for a single, Biplap wanted to come back for the second but the non-striker was having none of it, for the second time the throw is next to the stumps and gone by a mile
fuller outside the off stump, tries to jam his bat down in time get something on it, but misses, through to the keeper
full-toss on his pads and that's flicked away through the square-leg region for a four
slower outside the off stump and tapped to the covers for a single

and gets it high in the air yet again, took the pace off it yet again, 107 km/hr, was very early into his stroke and gets it over to the deep square leg region, the fielder runs to his right, and goes for the catch, leaps at it but falls just short of him

and now, wow, what a stroke, it was full alright and he just jabs it back, was a slower one too but tell you what, it's gone straight and hit the rope! third umpire looking at it, takes a lot of time to decide on whether it was a four or a six...in the end, he's given it a four there
swings it and misses it, was a length ball and again, seemed a tad slower there, was way early into his stroke
slower one on the leg stump and he's too early in his stroke, chipped over the leg side for a single, was in the air for some time there
fuller on the off stump and tapped down to long-off for a single
edged and taken by the keeper! was a fuller, outside the off stump and he was looking to swing it away, gets an outside edge on it, easily taken by the keeper, big, big couple of wickets in that over
on a length and outside the off stump, tapped down to long-on for a single
length ball and outside the off stump, he was looking to dab it down to the third-man but misses
down the leg-side and is called a wide there
fuller again and driven to the point fielder, wants a single but is sent back

gone, run-out, what an effort in the field, what a throw, that's Sammy walking back! that was fuller outside the off stump, and he has to drill it through the covers, gets it to the sub fielder at sweeper, Shukla, he had to run across to his right and field it, throws it hard and flat and next to the stumps, bails are whipped off and he's out

slapped it over mid-wicket for a six! this was round the stump and for some reason bowled it on a length and outside the off stump, when you do that you are bound to be swung away by someone like Sammy, gets it for a six, he's charged up, the batsman
yes he does, yes he swings it away, yes he gets a six! that was a fuller one and just where he wanted, in his arc, swings hard and gets it for a six
poor last ball, read his intentions that he was looking to crack it away, slipped in wider but it's too wide outside the off
swings it, misses it and misses the stumps too! was a quicker one from him and very full too, was looking to get it over the in-field but missed
very full and quicker too, he jabs it down to long-off for a single
full-toss on the off stump and he's tapped it to the off side like he wants to get Sammy back on strike, single for him
fuller this time, tries to get him to drive it straighter and he gets it away to long-off for a single
and six more to Sammy, he's swung it away and over the wide long-on region for maximum, was on a length too
wow, what a shot that one, was a slower one and for the second time this over, it looked like he was waiting for it too, cracks it through wide long-off for a four
and again, the second bouncer of the over but this is above head high and called a wide
bouncer and a good one too, but he ducks under it like he was waiting for it, lets it go

and now he's get out to Faulkner! caught at short fine-leg! he was looking to play that same stroke, scoop over short fine-leg but this time he's hit it off the middle and straight to the fielder, gone to the same bowler he has had many a conversations with tonight

now he gets something for himself, he was struggling to hit it straight, this time he gets himself into a position to scoop it over short fine-leg, gets a slower ball, hits it over the fielder for a four
very fuller and on the middle stump, probably angling into too, can only tap it to the off side now
fuller, quicker and enough room to flay it through the covers, finds the middle of the bat but does not find the middle of the gap, straight to the sweeper
full-toss outside the off stump and he gets some bat on it to extra-cover, Dravid fields well but for the second time tonight he misses a direct-hit
full-toss on the off stump and he can only hit it straight to mid-wicket for a single
short of length and slightly slower, he was looking to pull it away but does not get it off the middle of the bat, on the bounce and back to the bowler
wide outside the off stump, fuller too and he brings him bat down in time, tries to jam it down but misses
and almost a four now, was round the stumps and he was looking to flick it through the short fine-leg fielder, Trivedi dives to his left and stops it partially
finally a connection, finally a six! it was on a length and he hits it across the line over mid-wicket for a six, muscled over despite not hitting the middle
and again, he slows it down for Dhawan, it was fuller and despite all his machinations to move around in his crease, all he can do is to drive it back to the bowler
wants to tonk it hard but that one did not come on too much and it goes straight to wide long-off for only a single
wide outside the off stump, one of the rare loose balls from RR, it was fuller and swinging away, bit quicker too as a change-up
and another one slowed down when he saw him come down the track, gets some bat on it and loops it up to the off side, single alone
and this time he does unwind and smacks it hard to wide long-on for a single

ooh, what a ball! A West Indian to a fellow West Indian, it was on a length and he seemed to have played it off the back foot like he was looking to unwind, beats the outside edge because of the extra bounce
goes down the track, wants to hit it inside out and Cooper spots that one, slows the pace down and he checks his shot through to wide long-off for a single
gets it fuller this time, pushed it to long-off for a single
short of length and tapped to the off side, straight to the fielder
outside the off stump and punched that length ball and through the covers, bit of a fumble from Hodge at the sweeper fence
slows the pace of the delivery down, was on the leg-stump too and he can only push it to the leg side for a single
short of length on the middle stump and tapped to the leg side
shorter in length and bit more bounce than he thought, adjusts well and tucked to the leg side for a single
fuller on the off stump, not too much swing on that one and it's punched down to long-off for a single
fuller this time and on the off stump, driven to the extra-cover area for a quickly taken single, Dravid has a shy but misses by some distance
and leaves it alone yet again, was outside the off stump that one and swinging away
shorter in length and out-swing yet again! he lets it go through to the keeper this time, who's up to the stumps
whoa, some swing that one, it on a length outside the off stump and goes away from the batsman, gets it through to point
fuller on the off stump and drilled back to the bowler, fielded well on his follow-through

and now he's holed out to Cooper at wide mid-off, gone! it was on a length and he was looking to pull it across the line yet again, the ball scoops up and down to the fielder, who takes a straightforward chance
slogs it across the line for a four! it was fuller on the leg stump, the attempt was to cramp him for room but he swings it over deep square-leg for a four
on his pads and glanced it very fine, the keeper gets some hand on it but beats him through to the fine-leg fielder who has to dive, came off the pads
shortens the length and he goes down the track, chips it to long-off fielder, goes to him on a couple of bounces
short of length and outside the off stump, tries to drive it through the off side, gets it straight to point
wide outside the off stump with the keeper up to the bat, Dhawan was trying to slog it over the leg side, misses
fuller on the off stump and driven straight to the short cover fielder
flies off the edge for a four, that was deliberately played, was on a length and outside the off stump, opens the bat and plays fine to the fence
crunched, that's come off the middle of the bat, was full enough to drive it straight back, but gets his hand down in time does the bowler
fuller outside the off stump and he drives it through to long-on for a single
shorter in length and outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single
short of length and angling into the batsman, comes in a tad quicker than he expected and it's defended to the leg side
fuller on his pads and pushes it to mid-on and they are quickly off for a single
shorter in length and he was looking to give himself some room, cramped by the movement back and can only push it to the covers
outside the off stump and bit of seam away from the bat, drives it through the covers for a single
slows the pace down there, was fuller too and White was looking to come down and drive it away, checks his shot in the end and it rolls over to mid-wicket
length ball on the middle stump, wants to push at it through the leg side but straight to the fielder there
doesn't he love doing that, over and over again, he skips a couple of steps down the pitch despite the keeper being up to the stumps, chips it and almost gets to long-on, on a bounce
a quick shimmy down the track and pushed into the covers for a quick single, helped no doubt by the fact that he had already taken those few steps down the pitch
seams back into the batsman again, he was looking to defend at it and it gets an inside edge to the leg side
shorter in length and outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and steers it through to third-man for a single
driven a fuller ball and straight to the short cover fielder

hooked away for a four, White's looking in that kind of a mood that he will go after anything that he can, it was a bouncer and goes for a hook, last time he had got out playing it, this time it gets fine for four
inside edge but from Watson's point of view, it does not roll on to the stumps but is off to the on-side for a single, was a length ball and he was looking to defend at it
and again, the tip and run bit, this is 'tipped' slightly harder and it goes to the off side fielder, but they still manage to get a single
tip and run, it was on the off stump and he gets his bat and pad together, defended it right in front of him and off they go
he's definitely getting some sort of movement back into the batsman, just a hint though, on the middle stump line and flicked away to the leg side
swing back into the batsman, it was on the middle stump and on to his pads, taps it mid-on
fuller on the middle stump and this time he's able to get the gap through the leg side for a single
middle-stump line and on a length this time, he wants to flick it away but never came on and rolls over to short mid-wicket
short of length and pulled well, that seemed to have been hit off the middle but Trivedi makes a dive towards his right and fields that, a bit clumsy but in the end restricts it to one
gone, through the point region for a four, it was short of length and on the off stump, he gives a punch off the back foot and beats the two fielders there
length ball on the off stump and this time his push into the covers has resulted in a single for the batsman, it's been a grind so far
length ball yet again, can only tap it through to the covers
keeps it very close to the stumps here, on the off stump too and defended to the off side, was looking to play it down to third-man, gets it squarer
on the middle stump and on length too, angling slightly away from him and defended back to the bowler

superb shot that, continues to bowl shorter in length but this is slightly wider outside the off, he stands up tall and taps it down the ground, easily beats the mid-on fielder and once that happens, there's no stopp it
shorter on the off stump and wants to crack it through the covers, hits it straight to the point fielder
loud appeal for an lbw! it was a short of length delivery and White wanted to pull, misses it and hits the pads, but looked very high and the umpire rightly gives it not-out
and again, takes those couple of steps down the track, and this is not full enough, just pushes it down to mid-off for a single
straighter now and short of length, the batsman can only push it back to the bowler
now that's the shot we have been waiting for, he loves playing it too, takes a couple of steps down the pitch and then opens the face of the bat and taps it through extra-cover for a four
short of length on the middle stump and tucked away to fine-leg for a single
another slower one and that's an excellent shot, he merely pushed at it and beats the mid-off fielder to his right with an ease
slows the pace down this time, outside the off stump and on a length, defended to the off side
fuller on the middle stump and he's skipped out and pushed it to mid-on
and now gets his length fuller outside the off stump, gets his bat out and guides it through to third-man for a single
short of length from over the wicket and that bounces much more than all that we have seen tonight, defended off the back foot
fuller on the middle stump and gently flicked away to the leg-side, should have been a single alone but Cooper misfields and they are able to come back for the second...and then a third
shortens his length this time and the batsman is back and defending to the off side
outside the off stump and quite full, gets hit bat out and defends it to the off side

gone, caught, that's number two for Malik! this was short of length from the bowler and probably deserved the stroke on any other pitch, here the ball's not coming on to the bat and he went for the pull, gets it some place other than the sweet part of the bat and it lobs up gently for mid-on to gobble it...two down and in strife
short of length and angling back into the batsman, Vihari taps it back to the bowler who dives to his right to stop it
short of length, outside the off stump, defended off the back foot to the off side
pulls his length back and it's outside the off stump, lets it go through to the keeper, ends a good over there
some bounce but angling away from the batsman, opens the face of the bat and steers it to third-man for his first run tonight
back to over the wicket this time and it's on his pads, flicked away to square-leg, again not for runs
fuller, outside the off stump and a good ball to drive away through the covers, gets a good shot going but straight to the fielder
fuller from round the stumps, changes direction this time, gets it to angle into the batsman and he defends it back to the bowler
short of length from over the wicket, angling away from the batsman, pushed into the covers

and gone, caught in the covers! checking for the no-ball but it looks like he's quite alright, it was on a length there and Parthiv was looking to play it across the line, gets bit of a leading edge and it goes high in the air, the fielder had to run back, stabilise himself before taking the catch
length ball, not too pace on it and he wants to hit it on the up, driven straight to the short cover fielder
oww, an outside edge this time that's in the air and then rolls over to the third-man region for a single
on a good length and middle stump line from over the wicket, he gets his front foot out and defends it to the off side
gets his line slightly straighter this time, fuller in length too and Dhawan gets his bat and pad out and taps it to the cover fielder
leg-stump line and swinging further away, flicked away to the fine-leg fielder for a single to get off the mark
was fuller and he's been hit straight and over the long-on region for a six to finish it off, what a shot to win a Champions League T20 place!

short of length and that's been hit over backward square-leg for a six! that's not the best ball you would bowl at this stage of the game, and Hodge takes full toll of it with the fine-leg up in side the circle
full-toss outside the off stump, that round-arm action that so resembles Waqar Younis' and he plays it to the off side for a single
and was looking to hit it hard yet again, why is he slogging all of them, hits it back to the bowler on the bouce

finally he gets it off the middle of the bat, cracked through the off side, he was looking to mow it across the line all this while but this time he's caressed it through the covers, White does well to get close to it, but still gets them two
and a third swing, this is wider outside the off stump and misses, to the wicket-keeper
another one, he was looking to slog it for the second time in as many balls and for the second time, he gets an inside edge, rolls back to the bowler

ooh, wants to swing it across the line there, gets only an inside edge and wants to go for a single, Perera rushes across quickly and has a shy at the non-striker's end, was a poor throw and that allows them to come back for the second
shorter in length and was looking to play it down to third-man, misses the outside edge
down the leg side and that's another wide given, this was a wide alright, not clipped anything this time, Parthiv has a shy at it and Steyn misses it, overthrow there
full-toss this, was looking for another yorker I think and it's been tapped down to long-off for a single
cracking shot, that's the best you can expect a number eight against a bowler of Steyn's calibre, was a fuller ball and smacked through the covers for a four!
fuller on the middle and he wants to hit over the leg side, hit straight to the short mid-wicket fielder there
bad ball that, down the leg side but well kept by the keeper, it's a wide and could have easily gone away for a four, it's given a wide but it's come off his pads there!

tailing into the batsman and he was looking to swing away, gets an inside edge to the mid-wicket fielder, White should have fielded that, he could have got the batsman out, run-out, fumbles it and they are able to get back for one
outside the off stump, on a length and he was looking to give himself some room to smack it over the off side, misses
short of length outside the off and that's cracked, off the middle of the bat and it's been straight to the point fielder
pulls back the length and gets it back on line, middle stump, gets an inside edge to which there's an appeal, pops out nearby for a single
whoa, what a shot, that's a tad fuller and its been drilled through the extra-cover area for a four, gave himself some room there too and gets a good result
another dot, defended to the off side, it was on a length yet again, played away to the off
shorter in length and he dabs it to the point fielder and rushes off, the non-striker was going nowhere and rightly so, it had gone straight to the point fielder
on the middle stump line and a good length ball, tapped down to long-off for a single
short of length and defended off the back foot to short mid-wicket
that's gone, fast, furious and swinging back, easily beats the bat and thuds straight into the pads, hitting it right in front of the stumps and the stand's broken, another turnaround?
it's on a length yet again but the batsman's on the back foot and dabs it to the off side for a quick one
short of length and outside the off stump, easily opens the face of the bat and gets it down to third-man for a single
short of length and on the off stump, tapped to the off side
on a length and he was playing without too much of foot movement, gets it down to third-man for a single
short of length and cuts it, but straight to the short cover fielder
fullish outside the off and defended to the point region, a loud shout of "No!"
the wrong 'un that, fuller, and driven to long-off for a single
short of length, outside the off stump and cut hard, straight to the point fielder
and now another six! third one this and suddenly the game's back in their favour, was on off the stump and thumped over long-off for another maximum, this is excellent stuff from the Aussie!
short of length and tapped down to long-on for a single
bad ball this, the previous two weren't quite bad, but this is short and he's gone back and that's been pulled away through square-leg for another four
shot, that's cracked, absolutely off the middle of the bat and it sounded like that too, slog-swept over deep square-leg area for another maximum!
pitches it up to the bat and defends it to the off side
and that's gone for a six! Hodge reads that one, was a wrong 'un and slaps it over the bowler, goes all the way for maximum, much, much needed
shorter in length and tapped down to long-on for a single
pitches it right up to the bat and driven through the covers for a single
on the middle stump and fuller there, pushed back to the bowler now
ooh, some turn there, was looking to run it down to third-man and that's gripped and turned, beats the outside edge
very full on the leg-stump line, drives it through the covers for another single again
on a length and driven back to the left of the bowler, he has to rush to his left to stop the single
this time he gets the cut going, was outside the off again and gets it wide of the sweeper fielder, comes back for a second
shorter outside the off and very slow, wants to cut it but beats the outside edge
short of length outside the off and tapped through to the sweeper fielder for a single

wow, that's some shot, it was caressed through the off side, was on a length outside the off again and he drives it through the covers, first beats the short cover, then beats the diving mid-off and it rushes off
on a length outside the off stump and punched down the ground for a single, was in the air but distant right of the bowler
on a length and that's nicely played through point for a single, the third-man comes around to field it
fuller on the middle stump and defended to the off side, was on the front foot there
on a good length outside the off stump and tapped to the off side, they are away for a quick single, Vihari gets a good bounce but misses the stumps, Hodge looked in
on a length and tapped down to long-off for a single
slows it down and on the off stump, turning away and defended to the off side
fuller outside the off stump, driven but straight to White at short cover
tosses it up to the bat and tucked away to long-on, it's not hit too hard and they are able to come back for a second
a change in run-up from Mishra, comes more across than straighter, pushed into the covers for a single
shorter in length and easily tapped down to long-off for a single

bowled him, this is hara-kiri from the batsmen, was on a length and there was a bit of an inward cut, he looks to play it through the off side and in doing so leaves a lot of gap between the bat and the pad, sneaks through easily and bowled
on his pads again, 126.9 km/hr, wants to flick it away but hits his pads instead
length ball on his pads and classy punch through the mid-wicket for a single, chased down well by Dhawan and restricts it to one
over the in-field for a single, he was looking to throw his bat at that one, gets an outside edge to deep cover
length ball on the off stump and defended off the front foot, straight to the fielder
short of length outside the off stump, goes down the track and opens the face of the bat to get it to point
shorter delivery, outside the off stump but a straighter one, tapped back to the bowler to end a maiden, a wicket-taking one too
straighter this time, wrong 'un and it bounces more than he expects, defended to the leg side
slows it down this one, on a length and spinning away, defended to the off side again
fuller on the pads and spinning away, pushed into the covers
gone, caught and bowled, soft dismissal this! floated up to the bat this one, he was looking to drive it down the ground but can only lob it back to the bowler and Mishra has got number four
fuller on the off stump and driven straight to the covers
short of length yet again, he's quickly back and flicked away to deep square for a single
on his pads off a good length, chipped away to the leg side for a single

what a poor stroke, now why would you do that? it was on the off stump from round the stumps, it was on a length and with the run-rate needed at less than 6.5, he could have done better than tried to slog it away, misses and the off stump and sent flat on the ground
round the stumps and outside the off, tapped to the off side and wanted to rush off but sent back by Rahane
short of length on the off stump and tapped back to long-on for a single
short of length and flicked away to backward square-leg for an easily taken couple of runs
shorter in length and defended back to the bowler off the back-foot
shorter and spins back into the batsman, was looking to play off the back foot, misses the bat and hits his pads, appeal for an lbw but going down

what a catch! sensational from Sammy! Watson's gone! that was shorter again and he goes for a pull yet again, gets it right out of the screws and would have gone for a six any other time, only this time it's a charged up Sammy who jumps high, as high as he can and plucks out a beauty!
very short and it's muscled away through mid-wicket for a four! that was hit rather hard by the Aussie all-rounder and it takes no time to get to the boundary
that's floated up to the bat and up to him, driven to long-on for a single
fuller on the off stump and driven back to the bowler, misfielded by the bowler and they cross for a single
and again, what's with that line of bowling so close to the middle and leg line, easily flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single
length ball and on the middle stump, not the line you want to bowl with the fielder up inside the circle at fine-leg, uses the pace of the bat and flicks it away for a four
big appeal for an lbw, that was a big appeal from a lot of them on the field but given not-out, hits the pads from a length and it looked like going down the leg side

and now Watson goes over the top, not as classy as the Rahane shot, and does not get a six either, but it's a good shot alright, it was on a length and he's gone through the line and it goes over mid-wicket for a four
on the pads and flicked away to the leg side for a single

wow, what a shot, and it's gone all the way! it's one the best timed shots you will see on this kind of a track, it was on the off stump and he's chipped down the track and just tapped over the bowler's head, short-arm jab and all the way
shorter in length and he was looking to go back and punch it back, gets it off the toe of the bat back to the bowler
shorter in length and tapped to mid-on, straight to the fielder and it keeps them rooted to their crease
on a good length and the off-stump line, defended off the front foot to the off side
swung across the line now, was on the off stump and he looks to get it over mid-wicket, bit of an inside-edge for a single
short of length on the middle stump, tapped away to the leg side for a single
walks across the stumps and flicks it away to deep square-leg for a single
shorter in length and outside the off, bit of seam away and he cuts it straight to the backward point fielder
it was a length ball but the bad bit was that it was too far down the leg side and easily clipped over the short fine-leg fielder for a boundary!
and now he walks across to the off side but flicks it to the leg side, plays it very late too and gets a single
on a good length outside the off stump, punches it to the off side but its straight to the extra-cover fielder
short of length and on the middle stump, easily tucked around the corner for a single
cracked away for a four, he's been bowled a length ball and crack, gone away through the covers, on the up and to the fence!
another one on the off stump, shorter in length and defended well off the back foot, back to the bowler
slower one outside the off stump and again, he's gotten his foot out and defended to the off side
gets closer to the middle stump this time, Rahane glances it away to short fine-leg but straight to the fielder
nice punch but straight to the cover fielder, length ball and outside the off stump, no swing there
shorter in length and outside the off stump, it's defended off the back foot to the covers
quicker and drifts it on to his pads yet again, carefully tucked around the corner to backward square-leg for a couple of runs

leading edge and gone, caught at point! it was on the middle stump, he was looking to flick it away like he's been doing so far, on replays it looks like there was some movement away to the off side and the leading edge's taken it straight to the fielder
gets the line outside the off stump and he gets his bat and pad together and defends it to the off side
that's not good bowling from Ishant, was looking to cramp him for room but Dravid gets it easily away through mid-wicket, beats Sammy there and it rushes away for a four
fuller n the off stump and pushed it to mid-off where Perera rushes across to field it
not the best of lines, down the leg side and easily clipped away to deep square-leg for a single
fuller and on the middle stump, tipped to the leg side but to the fielder there
and again, four more, off a contrasting stroke there, was much fuller and on the leg stump, neatly flicked through mid-wicket for another four!
shorter this time and outside the off stump, looks to pull it away, not quite off the middle of the bat but pulled well enough to get it through mid-wicket for a four
short of length and the same line, on the off stump and defended to mid-off
on a good length and on the off stump, he's solid as ever and tapped to the off side
puts it fuller this time and again bit of swing away, defended back to the bowler
short of length and on the middle stump, it was swinging away and he wanted to play it through the line, gets an inside edge to the leg side
